lines: Beyond the long corridor, beyond the door
You, poised to set out on a journey
It seems no words could ever suit this
The love letter I tore apart flutters in the sky
A melody that leans into the silence reveals a changed silhouette
There was a gentle you I saw for the first time
Sunlight through the trees swells, touching my fingertips
Within the single meeting with a single person, just once
Now the sole place I have reached is eternity
Thank you, I love you
I want to say so much more, but today
I just want to give you this bouquet
Everyone is alone, each of us
That’s why we were drawn to the missing scent
Mismatched kindness, fallen tears, bruises that met
All of them color us, blooming in full glory
Within the single meeting with a single person, just once
Facing each other, it will become a special day, please
Just like always, show me your crumpled smile
See, I won’t let go of the fingers we tied
Through the pale lace, a wind shakes the lowered lashes
Light pours down as angels alight
Come, let’s ring the bells
What a beautiful creator of this world
Surpassing every possibility, I
have fallen in love with you
At the end of the single meeting with a single person, just once
Now the sole place I have reached is eternity
Thank you, I love you
More than any words, today
I just want to give you this bouquet
Alas, toward the journey, this bouquet
